glossary.definition: (1) "Local law enforcement agency" means the police department of a municipal corporation in which an offense occurred or, if the offense did not occur in a municipal corporation, the sheriff of the county in which the offense occurred.
glossary.source_title: Section 2929.44 - Court-ordered to receive mental health evaluations; reports to local law enforcement agencies.

glossary.definition: (2) "Mental illness" has the same meaning as in section 5122.01 of the Revised Code.
